name: Grafana Cloud
summary: Grafana Cloud has a free tier with 50 GB of traces, 50 GB of logs and 10,000 active metric series a month. The Pro plan adds a $19 monthly platform fee plus usage, and Application Observability starts at $0.025 per host-hour, about $18 per host. Enterprise needs a $25,000 yearly commitment.

facts.text: The Application Observability service overview shows RED metrics (rate, errors and duration) for a service alongside its dependencies.
Grafana Alerting watches incoming metrics data or log entries. The alerting page does not mention traces.
The free tier keeps metrics, logs and traces for 14 days and allows 3 active users.
The Pro plan keeps metrics for 13 months and logs, traces and profiles for 30 days.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10,000 active metric series, 50 GB of logs, 50 GB of traces and 50 GB of profiles a month, 14-day retention, 3 users. No credit card needed

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Includes 50 GB ingested a month, then pay as you go. Traces start at $0.05 per GB processing, $0.40 per GB writing and $0.10 per GB retaining

hiddenCosts: Application Observability on Pro starts at $0.025 per host-hour, about $18 per host, and the free tier includes 2,232 host-hours a month.
Trace costs have three parts (processing, writing and retaining), so the per-GB figure alone understates the total.
Alerting is documented for metrics and logs, so alerts on trace data may need metrics derived from traces.
